statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead and privacy contact in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30 and change triggers
Risk decision rules; High risks to client funds never accepted
Annual evaluation with an independent settings check every second year
Annual policy review including the website security statement
Written, time-limited exceptions; none to rule 8.4
No client data to a contractor or vendor without written terms
Coordinator and bookkeeper terms: own MFA logins; 10-day breach notice; return of data
Five-question check for new tools; annual platform SOC 2 review
One login per person; no shared credentials or codes
Security key or authenticator app on email; platform; and banking; MFA everywhere offered
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Contractor access limited to their files; same-day removal; quarterly review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 30 seconds)
Sealed recovery codes held by the owner's attorney
Weekly sign-in and mailbox rule review; same-day alert response; external forwarding blocked
Security log of setting changes
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems
Full-disk encryption on the laptop and phone
No money moves on an emailed instruction alone; recorded callback; secure delivery of escrow instructions; client wire safety notice
Identity documents collected through secure sharing; texted copies deleted the same day
Independent backup of mail and files
regulatory_driver: Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.012(1); Fla. Stat. 475.5015

statement_summary: Five-year file retention; deletion of extra copies within 30 days; recorded device wipe
Five-year retention of security documentation
Family uses only a separate standard account
Automatic updates; antivirus; current router firmware
Separate home network for work devices
No client data in AI tools; fair housing check on AI-drafted listings; screening use per P10
Annual security course with a BEC module for the owner and the coordinator
Incident runbook with printed contacts including the bank fraud desk
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Call the sending bank first when money may be misdirected
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
Backup broker arrangement
